entityDescription:
Infinitivity Design Labs (IDL) is an SME studio based in the rural area of the French region of Auvergne, focusing on designing sustainable, meaningful and intrinsically motivating learning experiences, placing education and training in the spotlight of its core mission. The studio is also a French state certified professional training organization (DataDock), compliant with official onboarding, delivery and evaluation training standards. IDL focuses on three key activities: game-based learning, instructional design & training and usability. 
The studio has designed or provided consulting services around a variety of educational games for mobile devices, desktop computers, motion sensor controls, AR/VR technologies as well as interactive tabletops and surfaces. The studio is behind the LUDUS project award winning mobile game Ladybug’s Box: Early Childhood Mathematics for mobile tablet devices, the interactive video crowdsourcing platform ActivePlay and the transmedia project Koders, aiming at promoting a healthy image of coding to young audiences. IDL designs and facilitates playful workshops with participants of various age groups, using digital, physical and outdoor games as tools for learning.
 
IDL also focuses on instructional design by designing and developing Learning Management Systems (LMS) and relevant content. IDL works with Subject Matter Experts in order to identify requirements, define learning objectives, specify target audiences, define teaching and learning strategies, which encompass aspects like technical infrastructure, learning theories, assessment, content tools as well as the development of resources themselves. 
 
In the field of usability and user experience, IDL provides consulting services to various non-profit and for-profit organizations, like Disney, Technicolor and Amadeus IT. IDL promotes an ethical approach to design, which focuses on the impact of design decisions on culture and society and the repercussions of their application. IDL provides trainings around Design Thinking, Lean UX, the Double Diamond and the impact of design on digital cultures and ethics, during which participants focus on creating meaningful experiences for their users and the societies which they live in. 
 
Usability and learnability are two key aspects of IDL’s focus, which conducts user research in order to improve the overall learning and user experience of different types of interfaces and platforms. IDL provides web accessibility trainings and conducts web accessibility reviews, aiming at an equitable distribution of information and resources.

entityDescription:
UAB „Gruppo FOS Lithuania“ (FOS LT), established in 2015, is working in R&D, Biomedical Engineering, Electronics, Technology Transfer areas. Company works in partnership with leading Italian and Lithuanian research institutions in joint laboratories. Lithuanian Universities (KTU, LSMU), Italian Universities (University of Genoa, University of Salerno), ENEA are the partners of FOS LT. It has a strong experience in the international projects in healthcare sector. FOS LT successfully implemented „Biomedical electronic device for brainstroke monitoring“ project and has already acquired a patent “A method and biomedical electronic equipment thereof for monitoring human condition after stroke.” Project of “Multi-modal system for personalized management of the post stroke recovery” was selected to be financed from „Intelektas. Joint science-business projects” program and is successfully implemented with 2 Lithuanian Universities (KTU and LSMU).
FOS LT is a daughter company of Gruppo FOS, Italian company, which works in IT, Automation, Engineering and Communication sectors and is specializing in the design and development of IT solutions and offers a vast number of services to its clients. The services are provided both in “as a service” mode for the maintenance of systems and new developments at the customer’s premises, and through the design and realization of tailored “on demand” solutions (software applications, db and systemic assistance, cyber security, cloud computing, digital workspace and hardware supply). 
Gruppo FOS has got technological competences certified with the major providers of software design, software application, database and application server.
Gruppo FOS developed competences since more than 15 years in the field of Internet of Things (IoT), Smart Devices and in general provide software and support to develop solutions to allow the control of devices in a distributed system. Gruppo FOS has participated in many projects that involved IoT technology. Specifically, in the ISAAC project (ISAAC - Innovativo Sistema illuminotecnico per l’Allevamento di vegetali in Ambienti Chiusi per migliorare il benessere umano), FOS developed with partners ENEA (Agenzia nazionale per le nuove tecnologie e lo sviluppo economico sostenibile) and BECAR (BECAR s.r.l subsidiary of BEGHELLI group) a system named Microcomo. Microcosmo is a Field simulation system as a technological solution to study the growth of plants subjected to experimental conditions, it is a complete two area system, one epigean area where is growing the leaves part of the plant and the hypogeum area where the roots of the plant are growing. Both areas are controlled for cooling, heating, humidity and few other parameters and epigean area is controlled for light conditions with 5 Colors LED Panels too.

entityDescription: The Dark Cube Consulting Kft. was established with the purpose of colligating, helping and developing the regional and particularly the Hungarian space sector as well as the telecommunications industry. By doing so, we aim to conduct and organize space and telecommunications related projects in the most efficient way, and also to coordinate the activity of the participants of these projects. Our company is committed to support and promote innovative ideas, and research & development, as we believe and know that the spinoffs of the space industry affect our everyday lives in a highly beneficial way. For instance, the advantages of the space innovations can be traced in the area of healthcare, engineering, social science, natural science and other fields of science and our everyday lives. We believe that whoever invests in the space sector and/or in the telecommunications industry, he/she also builds the future of the humankind. In order to answer the most recent and crucial questions (e.g. blockchain technology, navigation systems, the “Big Data” problem or the “Internet of Things”) and to solve the most significant issues (e.g. climate change, energy and communication related problems) of the next generations, we have to utilize the opportunities provided by the space and telecommunication technologies. Our company intends to play an active role in the fields mentioned above.

entityName: CREA - Consiglio per la ricerca in agricoltura e l'analisi dell'economia agraria
entityDescription:
We are the leading Italian research organization dedicated to the agri-food supply chains. We operate as a legal entity under public law, and are supervised by the Ministry of Agricultural, Food, Forestry and Tourism Policies (Mipaaft). Our scientific activity covers agricultural crops, livestock, fishery, forestry, agro-industry, food science – and socio-economics . We have full scientific, statutory, organizational, administrative and financial autonomy. CREA was established in 2015, from the merging of CRA (Council for Agricultural Research) and INEA (National Institute of Agricultural Economics), two country-wide institutions active since mid of last century”.

We employ over 2000 people, half of whom are researchers and technologists.
We possess several farms and experimental fields, allowing us to carry out our studies in the same conditions farmers operate under. This enable us to validate the results of our researches, verifying their feasibility and to ease dissemination to the final users.
In 2015, we became CREA, former Council for Agricultural Research – CRA, a country-wide institution. The new organization foresees12 research centers (6 related to specific supply chains and 6 dedicated to horizontal topics) which are forming a capillary network of structures throughout the country. The reform of the Institution has allowed to rationalize financial and personnel resources, forming the critical mass needed to deliver cutting edge research results.

entityDescription:
Maxwell Applied Technologies is specialized in the design and development of highly innovative and advanced solutions for electronic applications in the digital, RF and microwave field, by exploiting the simulation capabilities of the most advanced EDA tools. Inhereted from the technological knowledge and experience gained from Televes Corporation, which created a strong R&D department in 1971 with the aim of positioning products and solutions at the forefront of technology and innovation.
SERVICES AND SOLUTIONS

- Design & Simulation: We offer design and simulation services for electronic applications, including RF & microwave subsystems, power and signal integrity simulation for high speed digital designs and thermal analysis of electronic systems, by taking advantage of the most advanced simulation tools (such as CST Microwave Studio or ADS).

- Manufacturing: Televes, the brand heading the group of companies of which Maxwell is part, has been driven towards industrial investment since its creation. At this point in time, we have undertaken the challenge of developing a fully automated Industry 4.0 ecosystem in which components, processes, workers and customers create a dynamic and sustainable technological environment. Our state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities include the latest generation of SMT assembly lines with the capability of mounting bare MMIC dies using pillar bump technology.

- Test & Characterization: Maxwell develops full turn-key services to customers that include test, characterization and verification processes of electronic systems in state-of-the-art facilities. We perform a broad range of product testing processes: from electromagnetic compatibility, or electrical safety to testing operating temperatures, resistance and humidity. We also carry out aging tests in extreme environments, or a vibration room to simulate the impact of adverse conditions.

EXPERTISE AND CAPABILITIES

- RF & Microwave: Design of a broad variety of antennas, (from dipoles, patches, horns, reflectors to electronic beam steering phase arrays), amplification systems (from Low Noise amplifiers to Power amplifiers exploiting state-of-the-art technologies such as Asymmetric Doherty amplifiers), passive components (filters, couplers, multiplexers…), integrated assemblies as well as custom MMIC design in III-V technologies. Our team has broad experience in the design of passive hardware and antennas for satellite applications (communications, navigation or scientific satellites). Working with several technologies from UHF frequency bands up to Q/V bands. They are also experienced on GSTP and ARTES programs development.

- Electronic Boards & Digital Systems: Our expertise is mainly focused on Signal Integrity, Power Integrity and EMI simulation and analysis of integrated circuits and printed circuit boards (PCBs). We also perform design and simulation of digital communication systems, including a wide variety of signal processing blocks such as digital filters, adaptive systems or digital automatic gain controls. Maxwell is also specialized in the development of digital systems on high performance FPGAs and high speed DACs/ADCs.

- Electronic thermal Analysis: We provide heat transfer and dynamic fluid simulations for optimal thermal design of integrated circuits, PCBs and electronic subsystems by exploiting most advanced CFD techniques.

entityDescription:
NONPARTISAN EXPERT ACTIVITY
Specializing in making strategic recommendations, our Institute lays down the paths for the advancement of key public policies offering substantive support for Polish and European decision-makers alike. Our think tank fellows produce nonpartisan and independent reports and analyses, and their conclusions are an essential source of information for the private sector and civil society.
As a leader among Polish non-governmental organisations, the Kosciuszko Institute runs a range of national and international projects devoted to multifaceted aspects of security, including energy and economic security as well as cybersecurity. Engaging key policy and business stakeholders, the representatives of international organisations and the NGO sector in collaborative efforts, our Institute initiates socio-political debate on the most pressing challenges facing Poland and Europe.
Due to its leadership position, our think tank attracts the best analysts from all over the world to launch multiple pioneering and innovative ventures. The Kosciuszko Institute is the originator and organiser of the European Cybersecurity Forum – CYBERSEC, an annual conference dedicated to the strategic aspects of cyberspace. The first edition of the event was held in 2015. Recognising its pivotal role as a platform for regular dialogue between key stakeholders, Concise Courses has ranked the event among the top five cybersecurity conferences in Europe. As part of the CYBERSEC initiative, we have also rolled out a national edition of the conference: the Polish Cybersecurity Forum – CYBERSEC PL.
TRUSTED PARTNER
For over 15 years, the Kosciuszko Institute has put consistent effort into building close and durable relationships with a wide array of actors for whom our country’s dynamic development, political and economic stability and security have become their highest priority.
Among the numerous partners collaborating with our Institute, we should mention Polish and European public institutions, international organisations, national champions representing different sectors of the economy, world’s business leaders, top-tier think tanks from Poland and abroad, and the most influential, opinion-forming media.
A network of institutions which act as patrons for the Institute’s initiatives and projects includes the European Parliament, the European Commission, NATO, the Chancellery of the Prime Minister of Poland, the Chancellery of the President of Poland, the National Security Bureau, the Ministry of Economic Development, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Poland, the Ministry of National Defence, the Ministry of Digital Affairs, the Ministry of the Interior and Administration, the Ministry of Science and Higher Education, the Ministry of Infrastructure and Construction, the Ministry of Finance, the Government Security Centre, the Supreme Audit Office, the Ministry of Energy, the National Public Prosecutor’s Office, and the World Bank.

entityDescription:
STEP RI is a science and technology park established in 2008 by the University of Rijeka in order to become the premier science and technology hub and to foster cooperation between the academia and the business sector. STEP RI has defined consulting programs and advising processes for the establishment of start-ups, new product and service development, scaling-up of existing businesses, IPR protection, access to finance, needs assessment and commercialization strategies for SMEs and scientists that want to become entrepreneurs. STEP RI is a recognized centre for innovative and entrepreneurial support infrastructure of the Ministry of Economy of the Republic of Croatia, a member of the National network of BSOs (BOND) and a partner in the Croatian EEN consortium, offering its advisory services and practical support to clients from Croatia or clients interested in doing business in Croatia.
STEP RI is providing educational programs based on global up-to-date best practices such as: design thinking, creation of disruptive and sustainable innovations – products and services, product and business model innovation, pricing strategies, crowdfunding, business transfer and servitization. Since 2013 we have provided business consultation to more than 1.500 companies, scientists and start-ups and organized various events and workshops (350+ trainings for more than 6.000 participants), which makes us a major regional provider of business know-how. entityDescription:
Proficio is an award-winning managed security services provider (MSSP), delivering 24/7 security monitoring and managed detection and response (MDR) services to organizations around the world. Since Proficio was founded ten years ago, we have grown significantly. Today we help enterprises across multiple industries by providing the highest level of cybersecurity protection at an affordable cost.
Proficio’s team of security experts works around-the-clock from our Security Operations Centers (SOCS) in San Diego, Singapore, and Barcelona monitoring security events and hunting for targeted attacks. We use a combination of propriety tools and industry-leading security technologies to detect threats and contain attacks before they can cause damage.

Proficio invented the concept of SOC-as-a-Service to describe how clients benefit from 24/7 monitoring and the same advanced threat detection technology that is used in sophisticated SOCs serving large enterprises and governments. Our mission is to deliver these capabilities to our clients without the cost and complexity associated with building a 24/7 SOC. Before the acronyms MDR and SOAR were created, Proficio was providing our clients Active Defense – an automated response service to contain threats in real-time.
Proficio has been highlighted in Gartner’s MDR Service Guide annually since 2017 and was also the first MSSP to provide cybersecurity business intelligence. Our patent-pending risk scoring algorithm quantifies risk based on applied security and shows industry peer group comparisons of overall risk.

Company description: METID (Methods and Innovative Technologies for Learning, https://www.metid.polimi.it/) is the “Innovation Teaching and Learning Center” of the Politecnico di Milano (https://www.polimi.it/). 
We design and test methods and tools for learning innovation and faculty development.
METID operates since 1996 taking part in numerous international networks and supporting teachers through an ecosystem of formal and informal resources. - International Seminars dedicated to structured training with an active class dimension.
METID also deals with learning spaces and innovative technologies: the development of effective innovative teaching strategies requires digital infrastructures and spaces for learning that support the development of the “active classroom” with small, medium-sized and large classes. 
Digital technologies make possible the creation of a new relationship with contents and change their role in the learning experience by becoming drivers of new teaching approaches. So, in addition to keep studying new technologies that could enrich the teaching and learning experiences, METID also provides online learning with the MOOCs platform POK. The online courses are designed to support students in the key steps of their career, to promote learning innovation and to spread knowledge for an informed citizenship.

entityDescription:
KING ICT is a regional systems integrator, and the leader in developing and implementing innovative enterprise solutions. Our primary drivers are knowledge, expertise, creativity and motivation to improve businesses and to create added value. Through innovative ICT solutions, we aim to build a more connected and digital future for our generation and future generations.
Our approach 
New technologies, combined with our knowledge, skills and individualised approach enable us to develop solutions that contribute to the quality of operations, and correspond to customer needs. We offer support and consultation services on digital transformation, through the implementation of adequate technological solutions.
Customers
The solutions we deliver range from highly specialised ones to those used by a great number of people in everyday life. Our customers come from a range of different branches, such as transport, energy, agriculture, health care, education, judiciary, trade, finance, telecommunications and many others. Our goal is to build a connected and digital future for our generation and future generations.
Solutions
Our innovative enterprise solutions are based on new technologies, cloud and mobile first principles. We develop and integrate solutions such as ERP, DMS or CRM, and products for managing employee efficiency such as HRplus. We build data centres, optimise IT infrastructure, implement security solutions and research and develop new ways of managing information, which has led to the creation of systems such as the BI system for business reporting and the GIS solution for the exchange of spatial data.
International standards 
Customer satisfaction is one of our main priorities and the foundation of our operations. All business processes have been aligned with international standards. Our quality control system has been designed in accordance with the principles and requirements laid down by the ISO 9001 international norm. For all processes, we ensure levels of quality control and information security, as prescribed by the international norm for managing information security 27001. We also care for the environment, the impacts of operations on the environment, and the legacy we leave to future generations. Therefore, our operations are also in compliance with the ISO 14001 environmental management international certificate.
Compliance with recommendations 
All project phases are executed in compliance with the recommendations of the methods PMI, ITIL, IPMA and Agile. We have a business security certificate pursuant to the Act on Degrees of Information Security TAJNO (National level TAJNO, NATO SECRET, EU SECRET). Our operations are also aligned with the legal regulations of the Republic of Croatia in the areas of technical protection.

Our customers come from a range of different branches, such as transport, energy, agriculture, health care, education, judiciary, trade, finance, telecommunications and many others. Our goal is to build a connected and digital future for our generation and future generations.
Solutions
Our innovative enterprise solutions are based on new technologies, cloud and mobile first principles. We develop and integrate solutions such as ERP, DMS or CRM, and products for managing employee efficiency such as HRplus. We build data centres, optimise IT infrastructure, implement security solutions and research and develop new ways of managing information, which has led to the creation of systems such as the BI system for business reporting and the GIS solution for the exchange of spatial data.
International standards 
Customer satisfaction is one of our main priorities and the foundation of our operations. All business processes have been aligned with international standards. Our quality control system has been designed in accordance with the principles and requirements laid down by the ISO 9001 international norm. For all processes, we ensure levels of quality control and information security, as prescribed by the international norm for managing information security 27001. We also care for the environment, the impacts of operations on the environment, and the legacy we leave to future generations. Therefore, our operations are also in compliance with the ISO 14001 environmental management international certificate.
Compliance with recommendations 
All project phases are executed in compliance with the recommendations of the methods PMI, ITIL, IPMA and Agile. We have a business security certificate pursuant to the Act on Degrees of Information Security TAJNO (National level TAJNO, NATO SECRET, EU SECRET). Our operations are also aligned with the legal regulations of the Republic of Croatia in the areas of technical protection.

entityDescription:
Fondazione Giacomo Brodolini S.r.l. SB (FGB SRL SB) is a research centre inspired by the principles of labour and social inclusion, welfare promotion, territorial cohesion, sustainability, and technological innovation to boost economic growth, attention to the environment, access to employment through new skills, gender and cultural diversity and respect for fundamental human rights, and participation for local development.
The main purpose of FGB SRL SB is the creation of social impact through promotion of study and research, design and evaluation of public policies, planning of actions, and education and cultural production, which have an impact on the territories, organisations, and people forming the community in which the company grows and operates at national and international level. 
FGB SRL SB provides services and consultancy for: a) the analysis and evaluation of public policies and of public and private programmes and projects; b) research and analysis of data; c) the development of territorial networks; d) the provision of vocational education for both public and private bodies; e) the study and development of analysis and forecast models for the design and implementation of public policies; f) the development of models to measure the social economic impact, as well as the study and development of new models of active policies to meet the present and future economic and social needs and to overcome inequalities; g) support and advice to public and private entities operating in the same sectors and with the same purposes, also with the development and support of public/private partnership models for the management of interventions, and the implementation of innovative policies; and h) the publication and dissemination of studies and research on the topics mentioned above. FGB SRL SB furthermore provides cultural and advisory services to the public administration for: institutional communication; the organisation of events and dissemination of public, employment, training, inclusion and welfare, innovation, and social cohesion policies; and the promotion of territorial cooperation activities at national and transnational level.
